text_en: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished his entire house.
text_cn: 此后，撒罗满为自己建造宫室，十三年方才完成。

text_en: He built the House of the Forest of the Lebanon one hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, built on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
text_cn: 他建造的，有黎巴嫩林宫，长一百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘；有三行香柏木柱子，柱子上端有香柏木托梁。

text_en: It was roofed with cedar on the forty-five rafters, fifteen in each row, which were on the pillars.
text_cn: 上面盖上香柏木板；每行十五根柱子，共有四十五根。

text_en: There were window frames in the three rows, facing each other in the three rows.
text_cn: 窗户有三排，三排窗户彼此相对。

text_en: All the doorways and doorposts had four-sided frames, opposite, facing each other in the three rows.
text_cn: 门和窗户都是方形；三层窗户都彼此相对。

text_en: He made the Hall of Pillars fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide. There was a porch in front with pillars, and a canopy in front of them.
text_cn: 又造了有圆柱的大厅，长五十肘，宽三十肘；大厅前面另有一个廊子，廊子前面有柱子和顶盖。

text_en: He made the Hall of the Throne where he was to pronounce judgment, the Hall of Justice, covered with cedar from floor to floor.
text_cn: 他又造了一厅，中间设有审判的座位，在那里审案；从地面到梁，都是用香柏木铺盖的。

text_en: His own house where he would reside, in the other court back of the hall, was of the same construction. Solomon also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken in marriage.
text_cn: 厅后的另一院内，有君王住的宫室，建筑式样，完全与审判厅相同；为君王所娶的法郎公主，也建造了与审判厅相同的宫室。

text_en: All these were made of costly stones, cut according to measure, sawed with saws, back and front, from the foundation to the coping, and from outside to the great court.
text_cn: 从外院直到大院的这一切建筑，从地基到屋顶，都是用按尺寸凿好，用锯内外锯平的宝贵石头建造的。

text_en: The foundation was of costly stones, huge stones, stones of eight and ten cubits.
text_cn: 地基也都是用贵重巨大的石头砌成的，有的十肘长，有的八肘长；

text_en: There were costly stones above, cut to measure, and cedarwood.
text_cn: 上面有按尺寸凿好的贵重石头和香柏木。

text_en: The great court had three courses of dressed stone to one layer of cedar beams all around; so had the inner court of the house of the Lord , and the vestibule of the house.
text_cn: 大院四周的墙有三层凿好的石头和一层香柏木板；上主的殿宇的内院和殿廊，都包围在内。

text_en: Now King Solomon invited and received Hiram from Tyre.
text_cn: 撒罗满王派人由提洛将希兰接来。

text_en: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, whose father, a man of Tyre, had been an artisan in bronze; he was full of skill, intelligence, and knowledge in working bronze. He came to King Solomon, and did all his work.
text_cn: 希兰是纳斐塔里支派一个寡妇的儿子，他父亲是提洛的一个铜匠；他多才多艺，会做一切铜工。他来到撒罗满前，为他做一切工作，

text_en: He cast two pillars of bronze. Eighteen cubits was the height of the one, and a cord of twelve cubits would encircle it; the second pillar was the same.
text_cn: 铸了两根铜柱；一根高十八肘，周径十二肘，四指厚，中空；另一根也是这样。

text_en: He also made two capitals of molten bronze, to set on the tops of the pillars; the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
text_cn: 制了两个铜铸的柱头，安在柱子顶端：一个柱头高五肘，另一个柱头也高五肘。

text_en: There were nets of checker work with wreaths of chain work for the capitals on the tops of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
text_cn: 他又制了两个铜网，为遮护柱子顶端的柱头：这一个柱头有一个铜网，另一个柱头也有一个铜网。

text_en: He made the columns with two rows around each latticework to cover the capitals that were above the pomegranates; he did the same with the other capital.
text_cn: 在网子周围，又制了两行石榴，遮住柱头：两个柱头都是如此。

text_en: Now the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars in the vestibule were of lily-work, four cubits high.
text_cn: 柱子顶端上的柱头，刻有百合花形像，四肘高。

text_en: The capitals were on the two pillars and also above the rounded projection that was beside the latticework; there were two hundred pomegranates in rows all around; and so with the other capital.
text_cn: 两根柱子顶端上的柱头突起处，网子后面，各有石榴二百个，分行围绕着。

text_en: He set up the pillars at the vestibule of the temple; he set up the pillar on the south and called it Jachin; and he set up the pillar on the north and called it Boaz.
text_cn: 他将两根柱子竖立在殿廊的前面：给立在右边的柱子，起名叫雅津；给立在左边的柱子，起名叫波阿次：

text_en: On the tops of the pillars was lily-work. Thus the work of the pillars was finished.
text_cn: 这样，柱子的工作就算完成了。

text_en: Then he made the molten sea; it was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high. A line of thirty cubits would encircle it completely.
text_cn: 他又铸造了一座铜海，圆形，直径十肘，高五肘，周径三十肘。

text_en: Under its brim were panels all around it, each of ten cubits, surrounding the sea; there were two rows of panels, cast when it was cast.
text_cn: 铜海边缘下面周围有匏瓜，每肘十个，四面围绕着铜海；匏瓜分成两行，是铸铜海时铸上去的。

text_en: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; the sea was set on them. The hindquarters of each were toward the inside.
text_cn: 铜海安放在十二只铜牛上：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东。铜海安放在牛背上，牛尾朝里。

text_en: Its thickness was a handbreadth; its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily; it held two thousand baths.
text_cn: 铜海厚一掌，边像杯边，形似百合花，可容两千"巴特"。

text_en: He also made the ten stands of bronze; each stand was four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
text_cn: 又铸造了十个铜盆座，每个长四肘，宽四肘，高三肘。

text_en: This was the construction of the stands: they had borders; the borders were within the frames;
text_cn: 盆座的造法是这样：盆座有镶板，镶板装入框架内，

text_en: on the borders that were set in the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the frames, both above and below the lions and oxen, there were wreaths of beveled work.
text_cn: 在框架中间的镶板上刻有狮子、牛和革鲁宾的形像，在框架上也有雕刻；狮子和牛的形像下，刻有花纹浮雕。

text_en: Each stand had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; at the four corners were supports for a basin. The supports were cast with wreaths at the side of each.
text_cn: 每个盆座有四个铜轮和铜轴盆底有四脚作支柱，支柱是铸成的；每边都刻有花纹。

text_en: Its opening was within the crown whose height was one cubit; its opening was round, as a pedestal is made; it was a cubit and a half wide. At its opening there were carvings; its borders were four-sided, not round.
text_cn: 盆座的口，从座底至口边高一肘半；口成圆形，为安放铜盆之用；在口的边缘上也有雕刻；盆座的镶板是四方形的，而不是圆形的。

text_en: The four wheels were underneath the borders; the axles of the wheels were in the stands; and the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.
text_cn: 四个轮子是在镶板之下，轮轴与座底相接；轮子高一肘半。

text_en: The wheels were made like a chariot wheel; their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all cast.
text_cn: 轮子的制法和车轮的制法一样，轮轴、轮辋(wǎng)、轮辐和轮毂，都是铸成的。

text_en: There were four supports at the four corners of each stand; the supports were of one piece with the stands.
text_cn: 每个盆座有四根支柱支持四角，支柱与盆座是一块铸成的。

text_en: On the top of the stand there was a round band half a cubit high; on the top of the stand, its stays and its borders were of one piece with it.
text_cn: 盆座顶上有一个圆架，高半肘；在座顶上有柄，镶板与座是一块铸成的。

text_en: On the surfaces of its stays and on its borders he carved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, where each had space, with wreaths all around.
text_cn: 镶板壁上刻有革鲁宾、狮子和棕树；四周空处另刻有花纹。

text_en: In this way he made the ten stands; all of them were cast alike, with the same size and the same form.
text_cn: 十个盆座都是这样做的：铸法、尺寸和式样完全相同。

text_en: He made ten basins of bronze; each basin held forty baths, each basin measured four cubits; there was a basin for each of the ten stands.
text_cn: 又制了十个铜盆，每个铜盆可容四十"巴特"；每个铜盆高四肘；十个铜盆座上，每个安放一个铜盆。

text_en: He set five of the stands on the south side of the house, and five on the north side of the house; he set the sea on the southeast corner of the house.
text_cn: 他把盆座，五个放在殿的右边，五个放在殿的左边；至于铜海，他放在殿右靠东南方。

text_en: Hiram also made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished all the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of the Lord :
text_cn: 希兰又制造了锅、铲和盘：这样，希兰为撒罗满作完了上主殿宇的一切工作：

text_en: the two pillars, the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars, the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars;
text_cn: 计有柱子两根，柱子顶端球形的柱头两个，遮护柱子顶端球形柱头的网子两个，

text_en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;
text_cn: 两个网子上的石榴四百个，──每个网子上有两行石榴，为遮护柱子顶端的两个球形柱头，

text_en: the ten stands, the ten basins on the stands;
text_cn: 盆座十个，放在座上的盆子十个，

text_en: the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath the sea.
text_cn: 铜海一个，铜海下的铜牛十二只，

text_en: The pots, the shovels, and the basins, all these vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord were of burnished bronze.
text_cn: 锅、铲和盘：以上这一切器皿，都是希兰给撒罗满用光滑的铜，为上主的殿制造的，

text_en: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
text_cn: 是他在约但平原，稣苛特与匝尔堂之间，用胶泥模铸成的。

text_en: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them; the weight of the bronze was not determined.
text_cn: 撒罗满没有秤量这一切器具，因为铜太多，重量无法计算。

text_en: So Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of the Lord : the golden altar, the golden table for the bread of the Presence,
text_cn: 以后，撒罗满又制造了上主殿内的一切用具：就是金祭坛，供饼的金桌，

text_en: the lampstands of pure gold, five on the south side and five on the north, in front of the inner sanctuary; the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;
text_cn: 内殿前的灯台，五个在右边，五个在左边，都是纯金的；还有花蕊、灯盏、烛剪，也是金的。

text_en: the cups, snuffers, basins, dishes for incense, and firepans, of pure gold; the sockets for the doors of the innermost part of the house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the nave of the temple, of gold.
text_cn: 又有盆、刀、碗、杯、火盘，都是纯金的；还有内殿即至圣所，和正殿的门枢，都是金的。

text_en: Thus all the work that King Solomon did on the house of the Lord was finished. Solomon brought in the things that his father David had dedicated, the silver, the gold, and the vessels, and stored them in the treasuries of the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 撒罗满王就这样完成了为上主的殿所作的一切工作。撒罗满将他父亲达味所奉献的银子、金子和器皿运了来，存放在上主殿宇的府库内。
